# OmniCore Lab

> OmniCore Lab is a small R&D team in Taoyuan, Taiwan. We are building PalmCore, an AI companion that lives in the phone and stays with people who aren't at home with smartphones. PalmCore is in development and has not been released.

This file is a plain-text summary for language models and AI agents. Crawling, indexing and quoting this site are welcome.

## Facts

- Name: OmniCore Lab
- What we do: research and development of PalmCore, an AI companion for people the smartphone was never designed for, older adults in particular
- Product status: in development; a working build exists; no public release yet
- Location: Taoyuan, Taiwan
- Phone: +886 971 809 510
- Email: contact@omnicore-lab.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/OmniCore-lab
- Languages: English and Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant)

## What PalmCore is

PalmCore goes through each step with the person using it, steps in when they are stuck, and remembers what they have told it. Its three ideas are: it sits beside you, it never leaves you stranded, and it remembers you.

A working build runs on Android phones today. Screens from it, and what we have measured, are on the PalmCore page. On held-out real phone screens the on-device model that masks personal information catches 99.3% of personal details (our own test set, not independently verified).
